name: Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
attention_variant: hybrid: MLA on 7 full-attention layers + Kimi Delta Attention (linear) on 20 layers
notes: Hybrid KDA + MLA, and the best KV-per-active-param ratio in the whole slice. Vendor: 48B total / 3B activated; safetensors total 49.12B. config linear_attn_config enumerates 27 layers split into 7 full_attn_layers [4,8,12,16,20,24,27] and 20 kda_layers. Only the 7 full layers cache anything. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 7 layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 bytes = 7 x 576 x 2 = 8,064 B/token (7.9 KiB). That is 8.7x smaller than DeepSeek-V3's 68.6 KiB at a comparable 3B active, and 46x smaller than GLM-4.5's 368 KiB. At 128k context a full sequence is 0.98 GiB of KV. The 20 KDA layers hold a constant-size recurrent state, which is why the number barely moves with context length. Note this is MLA on the full-attention layers (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_nope_head_dim 128, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, mlp head_dim 72 for the linear part). q_lora_rank is null so the query path is not low-rank here. MoE: 256 experts, 8 per token, PLUS 1 shared expert, first_k_dense_replace 1, moe_intermediate_size 1024, hidden 2304 (narrow), intermediate 9216. routed_scaling_factor 2.446. Context 1048576 (model_max_length). rope_theta 10000, no rope_scaling. MIT. Good local fit for the kind of setup that would struggle with a 671B.
